notes.title: Join the Cyberpunk Rebellion in Metroplex Zero During Deckbuilders Fest 2024!
notes.content:
Attention all deckbuilding aficionados and cyberpunk enthusiasts! Steam Deckbuilders Fest 2024 is thrilled to feature Metroplex Zero, a cutting-edge neo-cyberpunk team card battler that merges the excitement of card games, the depth of roguelikes, and the narrative of JRPGs into a single player experience unlike any other.

[h2]What is Metroplex Zero?[/h2]
Metroplex Zero offers a unique blend where strategy meets narrative in a dystopian future. Assemble your squad from a roster of unique heroes, each bringing their own set of skills and cards to the table. Whether you’re looking to unleash firepower, shield your team, afflict enemies with psychological torment, or strike from the shadows, Metroplex Zero has it all. Customize your deck, power up your heroes with cybernetic augments, and take on the evil megacorporations that rule Eurasica in the year 2280.

[h2]Why You Can’t Miss It:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Unique Gameplay Blend: Fans of Slay the Spire, Magic: The Gathering, and Shadowrun will find Metroplex Zero a compelling fusion of their favorite elements, offering endless strategic depth and replayability.
[*] Customization at its Core: With over 250 different cards and 70 game-changing augments, the game allows for a dizzying array of playstyles and strategies. Each of the 9 heroes offers a distinct approach to combat, ensuring no two runs are ever the same.
[*] Rich Cyberpunk Narrative: Dive into a world dominated by hyper-capitalist megacorporations and resist their tyranny. Encounter a cast of memorable characters, from poetic brainiacs and vicious AIs to celebrity streamers fighting for fame in a morally complex landscape.
[*] Strategic Depth: Select the perfect 12 cards for each hero based on your scouting and strategic planning. Level up your heroes, choose your perks, and customize your approach to each battle, ensuring you’re always prepared for what lies ahead.
[/list]

[h2]Celebrate Deckbuilding Excellence:[/h2]
Metroplex Zero stands as a testament to the innovation and creativity within the deckbuilding genre. As part of the Steam Deckbuilders Fest 2024, we invite players to explore this richly crafted world and challenge the oppressive forces with their strategic prowess and tactical ingenuity.

Whether you’re a seasoned card game veteran or a newcomer eager to explore the depths of cyberpunk rebellion, Metroplex Zero offers a journey worth taking. Join us at Steam Deckbuilders Fest 2024 and embrace the future of deckbuilding games. Don't miss out on your chance to redefine resistance and fight for freedom in the cybernetic shadows of Eurasica!

notes.title: Cyberpunk Card Battler Release
notes.content:
Metroplex Zero is a single-player Sci-Fi Card Battle RPG. It draws inspiration from games like Slay the Spire, Hearthstone, Monster Train, Magic the Gathering, and Shadowrun Returns.

What makes Metroplex Zero special and different?
[list]
[*]9 different heroes each with their own cards and strategies
[*]Build a squad of heroes that fights together with different synergies
[*]Minimal RNG! Drawing cards is enough RNG, we wanted you to lose or win on your strategic skill
[*]Strategic Depth. Not just "playing units" or "attack & block"
[*]Tons of Replayability! Multiple modes and many possible hero squads!
[*]The adventure Anti-Robot Setiments was written by legendary cyberpunk writer Anna Mocikat (check her out here: https://www.annamocikat.com/)
[/list]
